1. **Bxf7+** - Sacrifices the bishop to give check and expose the king
2. Black must play **Kxf7** (best try, as Rxf7 leads to similar problems)
3. **Rd7+** - The rook invades with a discovered attack
4. **Kf6** (if Kg8, then Rxb7 wins easily; if Kg6, similar)
5. **Rxb7** - Wins the queen or the rook with overwhelming material advantage

This is an **attraction** sacrifice - White sacrifices the bishop to pull the Black king to a worse square (f7) where it becomes vulnerable to the rook attack on d7.
